featured_reviews.name: Prashant Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Learning DJing from Vijay Sir was one of the best decisions I’ve made . He is an extremely talented and experienced mentor who teaches with full dedication and passion. His practical approach helped me understand not just DJ techniques but also how to perform confidently in front of a crowd.

A big thanks to Deepali Ma’am as well  she’s very supportive and makes sure everything from classes to follow-ups is perfectly managed.

The best part is that while learning, I actually started earning back almost 50% of my course fee through small gigs and practice sessions — all thanks to their guidance and motivation!

Highly recommended for anyone serious about becoming a professional DJ! 🔥🎧

featured_reviews.name: somya mehrotra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Attending The DJ School has been an incredibly enriching experience. The program is structured to guide students from the fundamentals to advanced techniques, ensuring a comprehensive learning journey. Despite managing a full-time 9-to-5 job, I found the schedule flexible and well-balanced, allowing me to stay comfortable with the timing.

I am especially grateful to the faculty for their dedication and professionalism. They provided in-depth training from the ground up and offered personalized one-on-one sessions that greatly enhanced my learning.

For anyone aspiring to become a DJ, I highly recommend this academy. It offers an all-in-one learning experience that equips students with the skills and confidence needed to succeed in the industry. I am truly thankful for this opportunity and the knowledge I have gained.

featured_reviews.name: Adorable Cats and Dogs
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was 10 years old when i first visited the DJ School Borivali and my passion for DJing and Music Production has always been since childhood. Now i am 18, and i have enrolled for the 1 Year Combined Course of DJing and Music Production and have just completed my DJing course..and it’s been an incredible and amazing journey so far!

DJ Rebirth faculty is really an excellent and experienced teacher and a great mentor.. Sir's teaching style is detailed, structured, and beginner-friendly, covering the very basics of DJing concepts and theory from the base to the most advanced and complex DJ techniques, making it easy to grasp, even for someone with no prior experience...apart from that, he also shares his Practical Experiences, Career tips, Industry Insights and important Life Lessons, required to grow in the Music industry

The environment and faculty are very friendly and motivating, with personal attention given to each student

You also get exposure to current music genres and technology, latest trends in DJing, not just Theorotical knowledge

We also get hands-on experience to perform and practice on Professional Industry Standard DJ gear and get feedback from Sir on your progress which helps you understand not just DJing and Music Production skills but also how to build a career and brand as an artist

If you’re really interested in DJing and Music production, I can confidently say that The DJ school Borivali is the best place to start and grow your career...Highly recommended to anyone with a dream to become a DJ and Music Producer just like me!
10 out of 10- THE BEST!!
